summary.text: Don Vigesaa is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 29 (Cooperstown) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Don Vigesaa's service as "House since 2003". The member page lists Don Vigesaa's committee assignments as including Appropriations (Chairman) standing committee and the Budget Section (Chairman).

paragraphs.text: The biography lists education as BS, Business Economics, NDSU.
It lists these affiliations and civic roles: Farm Bureau; Elder, Zion Lutheran Church.
Don Vigesaa is listed as married to Cheryl with 3 children and 8 grandchildren.
